Octen Search (fast, dynamic) returns each search in ~0.17s, the fastest of the 25 Search API products we benchmark, and scores 82 on the Artificial Analysis Search Index

We benchmarked the fast, dynamic mode of 
@OctenAI
's Search API in our Stirrup agent harness with Octen Search

posts.author: ArtificialAnlys
posts.name: Artificial Analysis
posts.text:
Time per Task includes search time and model time. Octen Search (fast, dynamic) takes 13.3s per task, the lowest of 26, against a board median of about 26s.

Search takes 1.6s of that (9.3 searches at about 0.17s each); the rest is model time.
